description: A woman in profile wearing sunglasses and a pearl earring, seated in a vehicle with a grassy landscape and distant hills in the background, bathed in warm evening light.
A person in a hat and mask bends over to examine a large animal skull on the ground in a dry, grassy area.
A male African lion with a full mane walks forward on a dirt path at night, illuminated by a spotlight, with low green shrubbery on either side.
A young African lion cub stands alert on a fallen log at night, illuminated by artificial light against a dark background.
A sunlit hillside with green shrubs and trees, viewed from a moving vehicle.
A wild warthog partially obscured by dense green shrubbery in a savanna-like environment, captured in dappled sunlight.
